title: Hardware Labs and Shift Registers
toolchain: no code on screen. Check every bit sequence (the shift-register trace, the demo, the parallel load, the serial link), resistor colour code and number you add in Python 3.11.9, standard library only: `python3 -I check.py`. The planner's checks are in PLAN.md (Decisions, 'Checked'). No HDL or circuit simulator is installed (iverilog, yosys, ghdl, verilator, ngspice: none)
